source_review.notes: Reviewed PostgreSQL 18 joined-table, SELECT, tutorial, and LATERAL documentation; SQLite SELECT documentation; and MySQL 8.4 join, outer-join, and nested-join documentation. All eight official destinations returned HTTP 200. Dialect and optimizer claims are scoped.

evidence: Checked bag multiplicities, pair predicate theta, equality-key frequency product, outer null-extension, semi/anti existential notation, and output-grain terminology.
Checked ordinary equality excludes null from true-matching key groups.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Semantic nesting is distinguished from physical join order.

evidence: Recomputed customer 1 contribution as two pairs and customer 2 as one, for inner count three.
Recomputed left output with unmatched customer 3, unmatched right orders 104 and 105, ON-filtered three rows, and post-WHERE two rows.
Recomputed semi customers 1/2 and anti customer 3.
Recomputed exercise frequency example as inner 6, left 8, and full 13.
numerical_recomputation.notes: All counts include bag occurrences and rely on stated ordinary equality.

evidence: Re-derived inner cardinality as the sum of per-key frequency products.
Re-derived left/full outer results as true matches plus preserved unmatched occurrences.
Re-derived ON filtering before null extension versus WHERE filtering after extension.
Re-derived semi/anti membership through existence and nonexistence without right-side fanout.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: No free reassociation theorem is claimed for outer joins.

evidence: Reviewed empty inputs, duplicates, null keys, orphans, one-to-one through many-to-many, composite/tenant keys, type/collation mismatch, and schema evolution.
Reviewed stored null versus null extension, ON versus WHERE, USING/NATURAL output, outer nesting, self joins, semi/anti, NOT IN null behavior, and null-safe equality fanout.
Reviewed fact-to-fact fanout, aggregate duplication, range endpoints/gaps/overlap, temporal time zones/precision/corrections, and lateral top-N ties.
Reviewed row policy, cross-tenant collision, snapshots, cardinality skew, plan estimates, memory/spill, and index write costs.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Final row-count coincidence is explicitly insufficient without per-key and per-side reconciliation.

evidence: Validated every inner pair against nonnull integer equality.
Validated each unmatched left row appears once and each unmatched right ID is identified.
Validated ON-filtered preservation and WHERE-filtered removal of unmatched rows.
The verifier matched exact nine-line stdout, empty stderr, and zero exit status.
invariant_checking.notes: The model excludes real SQL UNKNOWN, identical duplicate rows, composite keys, collation, temporal/lateral behavior, snapshots, authorization, and algorithms.

evidence: Reviewed all 15 customer-order candidate pairs and the three true matches.
Reviewed unmatched-side proofs by absence of any true pair.
Reviewed active-order ON matches before fallback null extension.
Reviewed existential semi and anti results independently of inner output.
proof_review.notes: No database-engine or production-data correctness proof is claimed.

evidence: Separated entity count from joined occurrences, stored null from null extension, ON from WHERE, and semantic tree from optimizer order.
Separated semi join from inner-plus-distinct, anti join from nullable NOT IN, and output count from correctness.
Separated logical join types from nested-loop, hash, and merge physical mechanisms.
Separated portable semantics from PostgreSQL, SQLite, and MySQL syntax/optimizer behavior.
